name: trace-liveness-0
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, TLCExt
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
Next == x' \in 0..1
Prop == <> (Len(Trace) >= 1)
====
config: INIT Init NEXT Next PROPERTY Prop CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
